summary: Freja eID Group AB (publ) develops products and services for digital identification in Sweden and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Freja elD and Fulfillment. It offers Freja eID, a digital wallet that contains, among other things, a government-approved ID, a mobile ID card for physical identification and mobile payment features and data sharing with consent. The company also provides private eID platforms that consist of online and physical identification, electronic signatures, onboarding, and user engagement; and CheckID overview, life cycle management, card, and shared devices. In addition, it offers fulfilment services that consist of secure services, mainly related to the entire life cycle of secure log-in equipment for internet banks, such as security tokens, logistics, inventory, order management, packaging, production and distribution via multiple carriers, including registered mail, returns, and secure, and sustainable electronics waste handling services; and PIN code management. The company was formerly known as Verisec AB (publ) and changed its name to Freja eID Group AB (publ) in November 2020. Freja eID Group AB (publ) was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Upplands Väsby, Sweden.
